title: Polish Scallion Frittata
description: A hearty breakfast or brunch dish packed with the flavors of Poland, featuring a crispy frittata filled with caramelized scallions and savory polish sausage.
instructions: In a skillet, sauté the chopped scallions in melted butter until caramelized.
Add the cooked polish sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, beat the brined frittata.
Pour the beaten frittata into the skillet over the sausage and scallion mixture.
Sprinkle shredded quick cheese over the top of the frittata.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the frittata cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
